_comment: Foods that McCance and Widdowson does not cover - supplements, jarred pastes, branded and composite products. Values here are the old estimates from before the M&W rebuild and are NOT sourced. Replace each with numbers off the actual pack. Same shape as foods.json; calc.mjs reads both, and foods.json wins on a clash.

beef_stock_cube.note: not sourced - M&W has chicken and vegetable cubes but no beef one, so I carry the chicken cube's numbers across. Nothing eats this dry; it exists so the basket can ask me for beef stock cubes by the cube.

breadcrumbs_wholemeal.note: not sourced - replace with pack data

butter_beans_drained.note: 400g tin, 235g drained, label declared as drained. Replaces M&W 13-559, which had fibre as N, not determined, and so carried it as zero - the tin says 7.3g. Another 235g tin rather than the 240g I had assumed, so the COUNTED entry and meatball al forno moved with it.

capers.note: not sourced - replace with pack data

chopped_tomatoes.note: Sainsbury's Italian chopped tomatoes in tomato juice. Replaces M&W 13-530, canned whole contents. Fat is declared <0.5g and I take the bound, which reads high next to M&W's measured 0.1g - the bound is the honest thing to carry, but it is a bound, not a measurement.

chickpeas_drained.note: 400g tin, label declared as drained, so it drops straight in against the 240g drained weight the recipes use. Replaces M&W 13-670. Half a can reads 146 kcal against 122 per 100g, which puts the can at 240g drained and confirms the COUNTED figure.

cannellini_drained.note: 400g tin, 235g drained, label declared as drained. Replaces M&W 13-666. The drained weight is the thing to notice - I had the tin at 240g, and 235g is what it actually says, so the recipes and the COUNTED entry moved with it.

frozen_berries.note: 360g bag, strawberries and blueberries. Fat is declared <0.5g - I take the bound, same as frozen_onion. Replaces the M&W raspberry proxy, which read low on energy and high on fibre.

frozen_onion.note: 200g bag, diced. Fat is declared <0.5g - I take the bound, same as the M&W rebuild does.

frozen_raspberries.note: 315g bag. For smoothies. Fat is declared <0.5g - I take the bound. No recipe uses this yet, so nothing buys it and nothing counts it.

frozen_strawberry_banana.note: 450g bag, strawberries and bananas. Fat is declared <0.5g - I take the bound. No recipe uses this yet, so nothing buys it and nothing counts it.

grain_pouch.note: Microwave brown rice pouch, values as cooked, which is how I buy it. Replaces M&W 11-864, white long grain boiled - so this is now brown rice throughout, not white. Half a pack reads 167 kcal against 133 per 100g, putting the pouch at 250g and confirming the COUNTED entry.

kidney_beans_drained.note: 400g tin, 240g drained, label declared as drained. Replaces M&W 13-660. The 240g confirms the COUNTED entry I had assumed, so nothing else had to move.
